home.name: Home
home.body: See what needs your attention and what's coming up next.

friends.name: Friends
friends.body: Add friends by code or link — PartyUp is friends-first.

sessions.name: Sessions
sessions.body: Plan game nights at a fixed time, with RSVPs and a waitlist.

polls.name: Polls
polls.body: Vote on times with your friends; the winning time becomes a session.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.body: Paint when you're free so finding a shared time is easy.

discover.name: Discover
discover.body: Find joinable sessions friends have made visible to you.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.body: Invites and updates land here; push notifications are opt-in in settings.

settings.name: Settings
settings.body: Open your account menu for settings — profile, language, and notifications — and to sign out. Replay this tour anytime from settings.

replay.title: App tour
replay.body: Take another look at the app chrome tour.
